rationale: The material prompt requirement is An application-wide architecture assessment across coupling, cohesion, layering, modularity, naming, and interface design.. At # Code Review Checklist, the source is scoped to Run a systematic multi-pass code review - correctness, design, security, performance, tests - and report findings ordered by severity with concrete, respectful suggestions. Use when someone asks "review this PR", "review this diff", "what's wrong with this change", or wants a pre-merge quality gate ; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
